crucialFeats: Bound the Butcher inside his power battery.
Kept fighting after his heart was removed.
Martian Manhunter cannot attack him telepathically.
Burned through the fabric of space with rage plasma.

dossier.advantage: Red ring instead of a heart and inhuman strength. The ring keeps him alive even after fatal wounds, and his physical power allows him to crush energy barriers.
dossier.mentality: A furious zealot driven by revenge. He knows no mercy or hesitation – he pushes forward with a fury that grows more powerful with the enemy's anger.
dossier.quote: I am Atrocitus, lord and master of the Red Lantern Corps. I am wrath, I am hate, I am righteous vengeance!
dossier.style: Brutal, primal aggression. Atrocitus charges opponents to physically tear them apart with his bare hands, supported by corrosive rage plasma.

fighterA.name: Atrocitus

powers: Red Lantern plasma output, constructs, blood magic and rituals, flight, and Butcher-linked rage dynamics.
tools: Emotional-spectrum manipulation and high-pressure ranged offense.
Ability to poison the opponent's Power or energy through contact with blood and plasma.
weaknesses: Prolonged direct brawls can reduce his tactical edge in favor of the opponent's raw strength.

victories: Saint Walker, Indigo-1, and Star Sapphire

crucialFeats: World Breaker scale allows for collateral planet and moon destruction.
Worldbreaker Red She-Hulk and WBH clashing broke the planet.
Nearly sank the entire east coast with a single step.

dossier.advantage: Limitless strength scaling and regeneration. The more injured and angry he gets, the stronger he becomes, making him practically unbeatable in attrition.
dossier.mentality: A stubborn and wild destroyer. He does not calculate or retreat – he pushes forward until all resistance is leveled to the ground.
dossier.style: Unstoppable close-quarters destruction. Relies on pure physical strength and constant forward momentum, crushing everything under his strikes.

fighterB.name: Hulk

powers: Gamma-based strength growth, regeneration, thunderclaps, and extreme stamina.
tools: Gamma radiation emission (in World Breaker mode), destroying everything in the vicinity.
weaknesses: Limited precision utility at long range versus dedicated control users.
Strategy set is narrower when denied sustained contact.

battle-dynamics.phase_1: Atrocitus begins with brutal plasma pressure, attempting to burn Hulk before he reaches a rage critical point.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Hulk in World Breaker mode starts emitting gamma waves that neutralize Atrocitus's ring constructs.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Hulk's escalation becomes unstoppable. Every wound only fuels the gamma loop, pushing the Lantern into defense.
battle-dynamics.analysis: World Breaker Hulk possesses a scale that simply 'burns through' Atrocitus's control in a long exchange.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: Atrocitus controls distance and dictates the fight's rhythm. Standard Hulk struggles to break through the plasma barrier.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Close-range exchanges favor Atrocitus's combat experience and his magical blood techniques.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Atrocitus wins on points or by knocking out Hulk before he can reach World Breaker levels.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: Without immediate gamma escalation, Atrocitus holds the edge in technique and control.
battle-dynamics.s3_label: Fight to the Death · World Breaker
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_1: Murderous fury from both sides. Atrocitus attempts to tear out Hulk's heart, but he regenerates faster than wounds form.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_2: Hulk erupts with energy that tears the planet apart. Atrocitus fights with his last strength, fueled by pure hate.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_3: Ultimate annihilation. Hulk crushes Atrocitus, turning the battlefield into atomic dust.
battle-dynamics.s3_analysis: Death rules are Hulk's element. In a fight of total destruction, his regeneration engine is decisive.
battle-dynamics.s4_label: Fight to the Death · Standard Hulk
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_1: Atrocitus strikes to kill, using plasma to incinerate Hulk's cells at a subatomic level.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_2: Hulk puts up a wild resistance, but the lack of World Breaker scale makes Atrocitus's wounds permanent.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_3: War of nerves. Atrocitus wins thanks to his ring-based immortality and superior attack precision.
battle-dynamics.s4_analysis: Even to the death, without the World Breaker level, Hulk can be halted by someone as relentless as Atrocitus.

fight-simulation.opening: Atrocitus charges with rage plasma, attempting to immediately break Hulk's armor.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Hulk enters World Breaker mode, emitting blinding green gamma light.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Hulk's rage escalation exceeds the ring's capacity to generate constructs.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Hulk's victory through total physical and energy dominance.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Atrocitus strikes with a fury that incinerates the oxygen around the warriors.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Red plasma clashes with green gamma energy in a giant explosion.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Atrocitus finds a gap and wounds Hulk in the chest.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Hulk absorbs the plasma and becomes even stronger.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Hulk detonates World Breaker energy, destroying the battlefield.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Atrocitus is thrown back and loses consciousness.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Atrocitus keeps Hulk at range with ring constructs, denying a clinch.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: The battlefield is flooded with Atrocitus's corrosive blood, slowing Hulk's regeneration.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: Hulk desperately tries to break through the plasma.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Atrocitus concentrates all power into one massive plasma shot.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: Hulk is downed and taken out of the fight.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: The referee stops the clash seeing Hulk's lack of response.
fight-simulation.s3_label: Fight to the Death · World Breaker
fight-simulation.s3_phase_1_event: Hulk strikes from the first second with power that crushes the planet's crust.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_event: An endless series of strikes that Atrocitus's armor cannot withstand.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_b: Hulk ignores a burned face and continues the assault.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_event: Hulk crushes Atrocitus along with his ring. This is the definitive end.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_a: Atrocitus dies in an atomic cloud.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_b: Only dust remains of the planet.
fight-simulation.s3_end_condition: Hulk's total victory through physical annihilation.
fight-simulation.s4_label: Fight to the Death · Standard Hulk
fight-simulation.s4_phase_1_event: Atrocitus strikes with lethal intent, aiming straight for Hulk's head.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_event: Atrocitus uses plasma like blades, cutting Hulk's tissues before they can regrow.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_a: Hulk loses regeneration ability at the wound sites.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_b: Hulk grabs Atrocitus by the arm, breaking bones.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_event: Atrocitus forces plasma directly into Hulk's wounds, ending the clash.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_branch_b: Both fall dead in rage's embrace.
fight-simulation.s4_end_condition: Atrocitus's victory due to the ring's higher resilience.

final-summary.line_1: Both warriors feed on rage, but Atrocitus converts it into control, while Hulk converts it into sheer destructive scale.
final-summary.line_2: World Breaker scenarios leave Atrocitus with no chance, as gamma power simply 'burns through' any form of blood magic.
final-summary.line_3: This is a clash of whether a life-sustaining ring can survive in the heart of an atomic explosion that an angry Hulk becomes.
final-summary.winner: Hulk (as World Breaker) or Atrocitus (against Standard Hulk).
final-summary.quote: “Rage is fire. Atrocitus is the fire that burns. Hulk is the wildfire that devours the forest.”

tactical-board.lane: Atrocitus must keep the fight within the Force's bounds before Hulk turns it into a gamma loop.
tactical-board.subtitle: Butcher versus Worldbreaker

verdict-matrix.case_1: Hulk 8/10. As World Breaker, Hulk is too powerful for Atrocitus to stop with constructs.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Atrocitus 7/10. Against the standard version, the Lantern's technique and plasma give him a clean victory.
verdict-matrix.case_3: Hulk 9.5/10. In a life-and-death struggle, World Breaker simply erases Atrocitus from reality.
verdict-matrix.case_4: Atrocitus 6.5/10. A fight to the death is a risk for him, but the ring offers more finish routes than for a regular Hulk.

x-factor.implication: Victory depends on whether Atrocitus can close the fight before the opponent's full gamma escalation.
x-factor.mechanics: Hulk grows infinitely. Atrocitus only grows to the ring's energy level, creating a hard power ceiling.
x-factor.psychology: Hulk is pure instinct. Atrocitus is intelligent fury – this difference decides the opening.
x-factor.example: Hulk regenerates an entire arm in a second. Atrocitus doesn't regenerate his body, but his ring replaces damaged organs with energy.
x-factor.question: Is the red rage plasma capable of poisoning gamma radiation, or will it become fuel for it?
